name: serena-companion
description: SERENA Companion™ — app personal de bienestar del trabajador (SERENA Centinela).

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @serena/server & npm run dev -w @serena/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @serena/web && npm run build -w @serena/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p e2e
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w @serena/web && npm run build:demo -w @serena/web && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
